interest: Tracks Maj. Ichiji Sugita, a key US-focused intelligence officer, on his 1940-41 reconnaissance tour of the US and Mexico.
overview: Dec 1940-Jan 1941 correspondence: Gen. Miles forwards Tokyo intelligence that Maj. Ichiji Sugita left Japan for a 3-month US-Mexico tour, with the report shared across military, naval, FBI, and State channels.
